title: Relational Progression Instead of Field Dynamics
intent: Clarify the primitive ontology underlying RT progression, identity, admissibility, and projection without modifying RT_core.

summary.statement: The fundamental object of RT is not a physical field but a dynamically rewritten relational array whose indices possess identity only through their current relational organization. Quantum mechanics and general relativity are proposed to be distinct projections of this common relational progression.

rt_observation.question: Can relational progression replace field evolution as the primitive object?

core_hypothesis.description: Reality is represented by an ordered relational array whose organization changes through admissible relational evaluation rather than field evolution.

interpretation.A^(n): Complete relational organization at ordinal stage n.
interpretation.n: Ordinal progression rather than assumed physical time.

projection_hypothesis.statement: Quantum mechanics and General Relativity are not separate ontologies but distinct quantitative projections of the same relational progression.

purpose: Map relational progression into quantitative descriptions.

important_shift.reason: Field implies substantive ontology while RT proposes purely relational organization.

possible_future_operator.note: Not yet mathematically defined. It remains open whether this operator generates candidate successors or selects an admissible successor.

possible_future_equation.warning: Illustrative architecture only. Not a derived governing equation.

relationship_to_standard_model.claim: RT is presently an exploratory alternative ontology rather than a replacement derivation of the Standard Model.

research_tasks.title: Formalize projection operators Pi_QM and Pi_GR.
Determine whether admissibility possesses a variational analogue.

key_insight.statement: The primary mathematical object of RT may not be a field but a dynamically rewritten relational array whose successive organizations generate observable physics through projection rather than direct substance.

governance_notes: Requires adversarial ontology audit before lexicon integration.
Should initially reside in Phase 0 ontology refinement.
